title: MotionShift: Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer via Planner-Evaluator Synergistic Adaptation
title_zh: MotionShift：基于规划器-评估器协同适应的环境兼容运动迁移

paragraphs.en: Existing motion transfer methods excel at exact, rigid motion replication from reference videos to target scenes, whereas they often fail to account for the compatibility between the transferred motion and the target scene environment in accordance with physical laws. In this work, we propose MotionShift , a novel motion transfer framework that achieves high-fidelity motion transfer while ensuring physical compatibility with the target scene. In particular, we design a planner–evaluator iterative motion adaptation mechanism, in which a Large Language Model (LLM) acts as the planner to generate motion trajectories by leveraging its strong semantic reasoning capabilities, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the evaluator to rectify the motion based on its superior visual perception and scene understanding. Through this planner–evaluator synergistic reasoning process, the motion is adapted to the target scene in a training-free manner. The adapted motion is then used as a generative condition for an image-to-video (I2V) model to render videos in the target scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionShift achieves high-fidelity and physically compatible motion transfer across diverse and complex scenes. Moreover, we show that MotionShift can be readily integrated into existing trajectory-conditioned I2V models, endowing them with realistic motion transfer capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的动作迁移方法擅长将参考视频中的动作精确、刚性地复制到目标场景，但往往未能依据物理规律考虑迁移后的动作与目标场景环境之间的兼容性。 在本工作中，我们提出了 MotionShift，一种新颖的动作迁移框架，能够在实现高保真动作迁移的同时确保与目标场景的物理兼容性。 具体而言，我们设计了一种规划器—评估器迭代式动作自适应机制，其中大型语言模型（LLM）充当规划器，利用其强大的语义推理能力生成动作轨迹，而视觉语言模型（VLM）则充当评估器，凭借其出色的视觉感知与场景理解能力对动作进行修正。 通过这一规划器—评估器协同推理过程，动作以一种免训练的方式自适应到目标场景。 自适应后的动作随后被用作图像到视频（I2V）模型的生成条件，以在目标场景中渲染视频。 大量实验表明，MotionShift 在多样且复杂的场景中实现了高保真且物理兼容的动作迁移。 此外，我们展示了 MotionShift 可以轻松集成到现有的基于轨迹条件的 I2V 模型中，赋予其逼真的动作迁移能力。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in diffusion-based image-to-video (I2V) generation [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] have achieved unprecedented visual fidelity and temporal coherence. Building on this foundation, motion transfer techniques have significantly increased controllability by enabling the replication of motion dynamics from reference videos to target images. These methods employ either explicit or implicit motion representations. Explicit approaches leverage interpretable control signals such as depth maps and skeletal keypoints [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] to provide structured motion guidance, while implicit methods [ 9 , 10 ] encode motion patterns directly from reference videos. More recently, structural alignment methods [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] establish cross-frame object correspondences to propagate spatial layouts. Despite their effectiveness in motion replication, these techniques largely overlook whether the transferred motion remains physically compatible with the target environment.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，基于扩散模型的图像到视频（I2V）生成 [1, 2, 3, 4] 取得了前所未有的视觉保真度与时间一致性。 在此基础上，运动迁移技术通过将参考视频中的运动动态复制到目标图像，显著提升了可控性。 这些方法采用显式或隐式的运动表示。 显式方法利用可解释的控制信号（如深度图和骨骼关键点 [5, 6, 7, 8]）提供结构化的运动引导，而隐式方法 [9, 10] 则直接从参考视频中编码运动模式。 更近期的结构对齐方法 [11, 12, 13] 通过建立跨帧物体对应关系来传播空间布局。 尽管这些技术在运动复制方面行之有效，但它们大多忽略了迁移后的运动是否与目标环境保持物理上的相容性。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose MotionShift , a motion transfer framework that explicitly addresses environment compatibility. Our framework decomposes the pipeline into two phases: Planner–Evaluator Synergistic Motion Adaptation , which ensures the transferred motion is physically plausible within the target environment, and Motion-to-Appearance Video Rendering , which translates the adapted motion into high-quality video output. In the adaptation phase, we first extract the reference motion trajectory and map it onto the target image via spatial transformation. A planner–evaluator iterative loop then refines this trajectory: the LLM acts as a motion planner that reasons about per-frame object states and outputs corrected bounding boxes, while the VLM serves as a motion evaluator that assesses the corrected trajectory through a pseudo video and provides visual feedback for correction. Through multiple rounds, the trajectory evolves from a coarse positional mapping into an environment-aware motion plan. Notably, this adaptation mechanism is entirely training-free. In the rendering phase, directly generating video from sparse bounding boxes places a heavy burden on a single model to simultaneously resolve motion structure and visual appearance. We instead adopt a progressive strategy: a trained motion generation model first converts the adapted trajectory into a semantic mask sequence that encodes both motion and object-level structure, which is then fed with the target image into an appearance rendering model to produce the final output.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 MotionShift，一个显式处理环境兼容性的运动迁移框架。 我们的框架将流程分解为两个阶段：规划器–评估器协同运动自适应，确保迁移后的运动在目标环境中物理上合理；以及从运动到外观的视频渲染，将自适应后的运动转化为高质量的视频输出。 在自适应阶段，我们首先提取参考运动轨迹，并通过空间变换将其映射到目标图像上。 随后由规划器–评估器迭代循环对该轨迹进行细化：大语言模型（LLM）充当运动规划器，对各帧的物体状态进行推理并输出修正后的边界框；视觉语言模型（VLM）则充当运动评估器，通过伪视频评估修正后的轨迹，并为修正提供视觉反馈。 经过多次迭代，轨迹从粗略的位置映射逐步演化为具备环境感知能力的运动规划。 值得注意的是，这一自适应机制完全无需训练。 在渲染阶段，直接从稀疏的边界框生成视频，会使单一模型承担过重的负担，需要同时解决运动结构和视觉外观两方面的问题。 我们转而采用一种渐进式策略：先由训练好的运动生成模型将自适应后的轨迹转换为同时编码运动信息和物体级结构的语义掩码序列，再将该序列与目标图像一起输入外观渲染模型，从而生成最终输出。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，我们的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify and formalize Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer, a critical yet overlooked challenge in motion transfer for video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别并形式化了环境兼容运动迁移（Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer），这是视频生成运动迁移中一个关键却被忽视的挑战。

paragraphs.en: We propose a planner–evaluator synergistic motion adaptation strategy that combines semantic reasoning with visual perception to produce environment-compatible motion trajectories in a training-free manner.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种规划器–评估器协同的运动自适应策略，该策略将语义推理与视觉感知相结合，以无需训练的方式生成与环境相兼容的运动轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Recent video diffusion models [ 1 , 14 , 15 , 2 , 4 ] have made remarkable progress in visual fidelity and temporal coherence, yet generating physically plausible object-environment interactions remains an open challenge [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] . This challenge is particularly pronounced in motion transfer, which aims to apply motion patterns from a reference source to a target image. Existing approaches employ either explicit or implicit motion representations. Explicit methods use interpretable control signals such as depth maps [ 8 , 19 , 5 , 7 , 20 ] , skeletal keypoints [ 21 , 6 ] , optical flow [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] , or attention maps [ 25 , 26 ] to guide motion generation, while implicit methods, including fine-tuning [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 10 ] and inversion-then-generation paradigms [ 9 , 30 , 31 ] , encode motion into model weights or extract motion features from attention maps. However, both types tend to entangle motion with the reference appearance, leading to appearance leakage and poor compatibility with the target scene.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频扩散模型 [ 1 , 14 , 15 , 2 , 4 ] 在视觉保真度和时间一致性方面取得了显著进展，然而生成物理上合理的物体-环境交互仍然是一个未解的挑战 [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] 。 这一挑战在动作迁移中尤为突出，动作迁移旨在将参考源中的动作模式应用到目标图像上。 现有方法采用显式或隐式的动作表示。 显式方法使用可解释的控制信号（如深度图 [ 8 , 19 , 5 , 7 , 20 ] 、骨骼关键点 [ 21 , 6 ] 、光流 [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] 或注意力图 [ 25 , 26 ] ）来引导动作生成，而隐式方法（包括微调 [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 10 ] 以及先反演再生成的范式 [ 9 , 30 , 31 ] ）则将动作编码到模型权重中或从注意力图中提取动作特征。 然而，这两类方法往往将动作与参考外观纠缠在一起，导致外观泄漏以及与目标场景的兼容性差。

paragraphs.en: Some works [ 29 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] mitigate these issues by using multiple reference videos to avoid overfitting to a single layout. Others focus on decoupling motion and appearance to extract semantic-level motion representations [ 11 , 13 , 12 ] or reconstructing motion information [ 35 ] to better align with the target object. Nonetheless, these methods generally overlook the compatibility between transferred motion and the target environment, often resulting in physically or logically implausible motions. Our work explicitly addresses this gap by introducing environment-aware motion adaptation before video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 一些工作 [ 29 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] 通过使用多个参考视频来避免对单一布局过拟合，从而缓解这些问题。 另一些工作专注于解耦运动与外观，以提取语义级别的运动表征 [ 11 , 13 , 12 ]，或重建运动信息 [ 35 ]，以便更好地与目标对象对齐。 尽管如此，这些方法普遍忽视了迁移运动与目标环境之间的兼容性，常常导致物理上或逻辑上不合常理的运动。 我们的工作通过在视频生成之前引入环境感知的运动适配，明确地弥补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly valuable in controllable video generation. LLMs enhance short prompts by providing detailed semantic descriptions [ 36 , 37 ] , structuring multi-scene narratives [ 38 , 39 ] , and translating natural-language instructions into coherent multi-step processes [ 40 , 41 ] . They improve temporal coherence and multi-object controllability in complex scenarios [ 42 , 43 , 44 ] through high-level reasoning. However, LLMs rely solely on language and can produce hallucinated spatial relations or incorrect interactions. VLMs address these shortcomings by offering object-centric understanding, scene parsing, and multimodal alignment. They effectively reason about spatial layouts [ 45 , 46 ] , track objects over time [ 47 ] , and verify consistency with textual or physical constraints [ 48 ] . Nevertheless, VLMs are less effective at long-horizon motion planning and precise motion control, as their outputs are often descriptive rather than directly actionable for generation.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）在可控视频生成中越来越有价值。 LLMs 通过提供详细的语义描述 [ 36 , 37 ] 、构建多场景叙事 [ 38 , 39 ] ，以及将自然语言指令转化为连贯的多步骤流程 [ 40 , 41 ] 来增强短提示词。 它们通过高层推理提升复杂场景中的时序一致性和多对象可控性 [ 42 , 43 , 44 ] 。 然而，LLMs 仅依赖语言，可能产生幻觉性的空间关系或错误的交互。 VLMs 通过提供以对象为中心的理解、场景解析和多模态对齐来解决这些缺陷。 它们能有效推理空间布局 [ 45 , 46 ] 、跟踪对象随时间的变化 [ 47 ] ，并验证与文本或物理约束的一致性 [ 48 ] 。 然而，VLMs 在长时程运动规划和精确运动控制方面效果较差，因为其输出通常是描述性的，而非可直接用于生成的动作指令。

paragraphs.en: A few recent works have attempted to combine LLMs and VLMs for video generation. For instance, VideoDirectorGPT [ 36 ] uses an LLM to plan multi-scene layouts, while PhyT2V [ 41 ] employs LLM-guided iterative refinement to improve physical grounding in text-to-video generation. However, these approaches primarily operate at the scene-level or prompt-level: the LLM generates textual plans or revised descriptions, which are then passed to a video generator in a feedforward manner. They do not perform fine-grained, frame-level trajectory reasoning conditioned on the target environment, nor do they incorporate visual feedback to iteratively verify and correct the spatial plausibility of the planned motion.
paragraphs.zh: 近期有一些工作尝试将大语言模型（LLM）与视觉语言模型（VLM）相结合用于视频生成。 例如，VideoDirectorGPT [ 36 ] 使用大语言模型来规划多场景布局，而 PhyT2V [ 41 ] 则采用大语言模型引导的迭代精炼来改进文本到视频生成中的物理合理性。 然而，这些方法主要在场景级别或提示级别上运作：大语言模型生成文本规划或修改后的描述，然后以前馈方式传递给视频生成器。 它们既没有在目标环境条件下执行细粒度的帧级轨迹推理，也没有引入视觉反馈来迭代地验证和纠正所规划运动的空间合理性。

paragraphs.en: Our framework addresses these limitations by assigning complementary roles to the two types of models in a closed-loop process: the LLM serves as the planner, performing frame-level trajectory reasoning through its strong semantic and causal understanding, while the VLM serves as the evaluator, providing visual feedback on the spatial plausibility of the planned motion through pseudo-video assessment. This iterative planner–evaluator loop enables fine-grained, environment-aware motion adaptation that goes beyond the scene-level planning of prior approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的框架通过在闭环流程中为两类模型分配互补角色来解决这些局限性：LLM 充当规划器，凭借其强大的语义与因果理解能力执行帧级轨迹推理；VLM 则充当评估器，通过伪视频评估为规划运动的空间合理性提供视觉反馈。 这一迭代式的“规划器–评估器”闭环实现了细粒度、环境感知的运动自适应，超越了以往方法的场景级规划。

paragraphs.en: Recent works have explored decomposing video generation into multiple stages to reduce the difficulty of directly synthesizing complex videos in a single step. By introducing an intermediate representation that captures motion structure, the generation process can be factored into a motion prediction stage and a subsequent appearance synthesis stage, allowing each to focus on its respective sub-problem. The choice of intermediate representation involves a key trade-off: optical flow [ 49 ] provides dense pixel-level motion detail but is sensitive to estimation noise and entangles motion with appearance texture; bounding-box trajectories are compact and semantically interpretable but too sparse to directly guide dense video synthesis; object-level semantic masks [ 50 , 51 ] offer a balance — they are more expressive and structurally informative than sparse boxes, while being more error-tolerant and appearance-agnostic than dense flow.
paragraphs.zh: 近期工作探索了将视频生成分解为多个阶段，以降低单步直接合成复杂视频的难度。 通过引入一种捕捉运动结构的中间表示，生成过程可以分解为运动预测阶段和后续的外观合成阶段，使每个阶段能够专注于各自的子问题。 中间表示的选择涉及一个关键的权衡：光流 [ 49 ] 提供稠密的像素级运动细节，但对估计噪声敏感，并且将运动与外观纹理纠缠在一起；边界框轨迹紧凑且语义可解释，但过于稀疏而无法直接指导稠密的视频合成；对象级语义掩码 [ 50 , 51 ] 则提供了一种平衡——它们比稀疏的边界框更具表达力且包含更多结构信息，同时比稠密光流更具容错性且与外观无关。

paragraphs.en: Our Motion-to-Appearance Video Rendering stage adopts semantic masks as the intermediate representation, but the motivation goes beyond this general trade-off. In our setting, the input to the rendering stage is a bounding-box trajectory produced by the planner–evaluator adaptation, which encodes the intended motion layout but carries no appearance or texture information. Directly conditioning a video generation model on such sparse signals places a heavy burden on a single model to simultaneously hallucinate object appearance, resolve inter-frame consistency, and respect the adapted motion layout. By first translating the adapted trajectory into a semantic mask sequence and then rendering the final video conditioned on the masks and the target image, we decouple these two sub-problems: the motion generation model focuses on converting sparse spatial intent into dense structural guidance, while the appearance rendering model focuses on synthesizing realistic video conditioned on that structure. This progressive design is particularly suited to environment-compatible motion transfer, where the adapted trajectory may deviate significantly from any seen motion pattern and thus requires a structured bridge to guide dense generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的「运动到外观」视频渲染阶段采用语义掩码作为中间表示，但其动机超越了这一通用权衡。 在我们的设定中，渲染阶段的输入是由规划器—评估器自适应产生的边界框轨迹，它编码了预期的运动布局，但不携带任何外观或纹理信息。 直接以如此稀疏的信号作为视频生成模型的条件，会给单一模型带来沉重负担，使其需要同时凭空生成物体外观、解决帧间一致性问题，并遵循自适应后的运动布局。 通过首先将自适应后的轨迹转换为语义掩码序列，再以掩码和目标图像为条件渲染最终视频，我们将这两个子问题解耦：运动生成模型专注于将稀疏的空间意图转换为稠密的结构引导，而外观渲染模型专注于在该结构条件下合成逼真的视频。 这种渐进式设计特别适合环境兼容的运动迁移，因为自适应后的轨迹可能显著偏离任何已见过的运动模式，因此需要一个结构化的桥梁来引导稠密生成。

paragraphs.en: While prior works focus on replicating motion trajectories or temporal patterns, they often overlook whether the transferred motion remains reasonable and coherent within the physical context of the target scene. This limitation leads to visually inconsistent or physically implausible results when the target environment differs significantly from that of the reference video—for instance, when the scene contains distinct terrain, obstacles, or interaction dynamics that alter how the motion should be performed.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管已有工作侧重于复刻运动轨迹或时间模式，但它们往往忽略了所迁移的运动在目标场景的物理情境中是否仍然合理且连贯。 这一局限性导致当目标环境与参考视频存在显著差异时，例如场景中包含独特的地形、障碍物或改变动作执行方式的交互动态时，产生视觉上不一致或物理上不合理的结果。

paragraphs.en: To address this fundamental gap, we formalize the task of Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer (ECMT), which explicitly requires that the transferred motion adapt to the spatial structure, semantics, and physical constraints of the target environment. As illustrated in fig. 3 , the same reference motion, when applied to different scenes, may yield divergent yet contextually appropriate motion behaviors, reflecting how environmental conditions naturally influence the motion’s evolution. Formally, given a reference video V d V_{d} depicting object O d O_{d} performing a motion, and a target image I s I_{s} containing a corresponding object O s O_{s} along with environmental elements O i = { O i k } k = 1 K O_{i}=\{O_{i}^{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} , the goal of ECMT is to generate a video in which O s O_{s} performs the transferred motion while maintaining physical plausibility with respect to O i O_{i} and the scene geometry—such as respecting gravity, surface continuity, occlusion relationships, and possible interactions with nearby elements.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥补这一根本性空白，我们形式化了环境兼容运动迁移（ECMT）任务，该任务明确要求迁移后的运动能够适应目标环境的空间结构、语义和物理约束。 如图 3 所示，同一段参考运动应用于不同场景时，可能产生不同但符合上下文的运动行为，这反映了环境条件会自然地影响运动的演化。 形式上，给定一段描绘物体 O d 执行某运动的参考视频 V d，以及一张包含对应物体 O s 和环境元素 O i = { O i k } k = 1 K 的目标图像 I s，ECMT 的目标是生成一段视频，其中 O s 执行迁移后的运动，同时相对于 O i 和场景几何保持物理合理性——例如遵循重力、表面连续性、遮挡关系以及与附近元素可能发生的交互。

sents.en: Formally, given a reference video V d V_{d} depicting object O d O_{d} performing a motion, and a target image I s I_{s} containing a corresponding object O s O_{s} along with environmental elements O i = { O i k } k = 1 K O_{i}=\{O_{i}^{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} , the goal of ECMT is to generate a video in which O s O_{s} performs the transferred motion while maintaining physical plausibility with respect to O i O_{i} and the scene geometry—such as respecting gravity, surface continuity, occlusion relationships, and possible interactions with nearby elements.
sents.zh: 形式上，给定一段描绘物体 O d 执行某运动的参考视频 V d，以及一张包含对应物体 O s 和环境元素 O i = { O i k } k = 1 K 的目标图像 I s，ECMT 的目标是生成一段视频，其中 O s 执行迁移后的运动，同时相对于 O i 和场景几何保持物理合理性——例如遵循重力、表面连续性、遮挡关系以及与附近元素可能发生的交互。

paragraphs.en: Achieving environment-compatible motion transfer is challenging, primarily due to the difficulty of collecting high-quality paired videos that share the same motion yet differ in environmental interactions. To address this, we explicitly adopt a two-step strategy: we first initialize a coarse motion trajectory through spatial transformation ( section II-B1 ), then refine the trajectory via planner–evaluator iterative adaptation to achieve environment compatibility ( section II-B2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 实现与环境兼容的运动迁移极具挑战性，其主要难点在于难以收集高质量的视频对——这些视频共享相同的运动，却在环境交互上有所不同。 为解决这一问题，我们明确采用两步策略：首先通过空间变换初始化一条粗糙的运动轨迹（第 II-B1 节），然后通过规划器–评估器迭代适配来细化该轨迹，以实现环境兼容性（第 II-B2 节）。

paragraphs.en: The initial trajectory merely replicates the reference motion and lacks awareness of object-environment interactions. To obtain an environment-compatible trajectory, we introduce an iterative adaptation loop that leverages the complementary strengths of the planner and evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: 初始轨迹仅复现参考动作，缺乏对物体与环境交互的感知。 为了获得与环境兼容的轨迹，我们引入了一个迭代自适应循环，该循环利用了规划器与评估器的互补优势。

paragraphs.en: Motion Planning. At each iteration, we provide the planner (LLM) with the current bounding-box trajectory, the motion description T d T_{d} , and the identities of O s O_{s} and { O i k } \{O_{i}^{k}\} . The planner is asked to (1) reason about the interaction mode between O s O_{s} and environmental objects at each frame (e.g., jumping over an obstacle, being occluded behind a tree, entering water), (2) output corrected bounding boxes 𝐁 n \mathbf{B}_{n} that reflect physically plausible object states, and (3) produce per-frame motion descriptions 𝐏 n = { P ( 1 ) , P ( 2 ) , … , P ( F ) } \mathbf{P}_{n}=\{P^{(1)},P^{(2)},\ldots,P^{(F)}\} that characterize the object’s state at each timestep.
paragraphs.zh: 运动规划。 在每次迭代中，我们向规划器（LLM）提供当前的边界框轨迹、运动描述 T d T_{d}，以及 O s O_{s} 和 { O i k } \{O_{i}^{k}\} 的标识。 规划器被要求：(1) 推理 O s O_{s} 与环境物体在每一帧中的交互模式（例如，跳过障碍物、被树遮挡、进入水中），(2) 输出反映物理上合理物体状态的修正边界框 𝐁 n \mathbf{B}_{n}，以及 (3) 生成逐帧运动描述 𝐏 n = { P ( 1 ) , P ( 2 ) , … , P ( F ) } \mathbf{P}_{n}=\{P^{(1)},P^{(2)},\ldots,P^{(F)}\}，用于刻画物体在每个时间步的状态。

paragraphs.en: Motion Evaluation. To visually assess the corrected trajectory, we construct a pseudo video from 𝐁 n \mathbf{B}_{n} by masking the objects in I s I_{s} , inpainting the masked regions [ 53 ] , and pasting the object crops at the bounding-box positions for each frame. The resulting pseudo video visualizes how the target object moves through the scene over time, making spatial conflicts and implausible object–environment overlaps directly observable. The evaluator (VLM) then evaluates spatial consistency and physical plausibility of the pseudo video. If issues are detected, it outputs correction instructions specifying problematic frames and suggested adjustments, which are appended to the planner’s input for the next iteration. The loop terminates when the evaluator reports no major issues remaining.
paragraphs.zh: 运动评估。 为了直观评估校正后的轨迹，我们由 𝐁 n \mathbf{B}_{n} 构建一个伪视频：对 I s I_{s} 中的目标物体进行掩蔽，对掩蔽区域进行修复[53]，并在每一帧的边界框位置粘贴物体裁剪图像。 所得伪视频直观展示了目标物体随时间在场景中的运动方式，使空间冲突和不合理的物体–环境重叠能够直接被观察到。 评估器（VLM）随后评估伪视频的空间一致性与物理合理性。 如果发现问题，它会输出修正指令，指出存在问题的帧并给出建议调整，这些指令会被附加到智能体规划器下一轮迭代的输入中。 当评估器报告不再存在重大问题时，该循环终止。

paragraphs.en: Directly generating video from sparse bounding boxes places a heavy burden on a single model to simultaneously resolve motion structure and visual appearance. To address this, we decompose the rendering process into two stages. In the first stage, a Motion Generation model converts the adapted bounding-box trajectory into a semantic mask sequence, which encodes object-level shape and spatial extent while abstracting away appearance details. In the second stage, an Appearance Rendering model takes the generated mask sequence together with the target image to produce the final video. This progressive design allows each stage to focus on its respective sub-problem.
paragraphs.zh: 直接从稀疏边界框生成视频，会给单一模型带来沉重负担，需要其同时解决运动结构和视觉外观。 为解决这一问题，我们将渲染过程分解为两个阶段。 在第一阶段，运动生成模型将适配后的边界框轨迹转换为语义掩码序列，该序列编码物体级别的形状和空间范围，同时抽象掉外观细节。 在第二阶段，外观渲染模型结合生成的掩码序列与目标图像，生成最终的视频。 这种渐进式设计使每个阶段能够专注于各自的子问题。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark. We use the Something-Something V2 dataset [ 58 ] , which contains 174 motion types and 220,847 videos, as our evaluation benchmark following [ 13 ] . We carefully select 10 diverse motion types from the validation set, each containing 11 videos. For each motion type, one video is randomly selected as the reference video, and the first frame of the remaining ten videos serves as a target image, resulting in 100 test pairs. Every test pair has distinct objects and environmental contexts, making motion transfer particularly challenging. Importantly, the selected action classes involve clear physical interactions between objects and their surroundings — such as rolling, sliding, and pushing — where the plausibility of the transferred motion depends critically on the spatial structure and physical properties of the target scene. This makes the benchmark well-suited for evaluating environment-compatible motion transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 按照[13]的做法，我们使用Something-Something V2数据集[58]作为评估基准，该数据集包含174种运动类型和220,847个视频。 我们从验证集中精心选取了10种多样化的运动类型，每种包含11个视频。 对于每种运动类型，随机选取一个视频作为参考视频，其余十个视频的首帧作为目标图像，从而得到100个测试对。 每个测试对中的物体和环境背景都不相同，这使得运动迁移尤其具有挑战性。 重要的是，所选的动作类别涉及物体与其周围环境之间明确的物理交互——例如滚动、滑动和推动——在此类情形下，迁移运动的合理性关键取决于目标场景的空间结构和物理属性。 这使得该基准非常适合用于评估与环境相容的运动迁移。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Metrics. Following [ 13 , 9 , 12 ] , we adopt four metrics for automatic evaluation: (1) Appearance consistency : we compute the CLIP-score [ 59 ] between each frame of the generated video and the target image, then average over all frames. This reflects how well the generated video preserves the visual identity of the target subject. (2) Temporal consistency : we compute the CLIP-score between every pair of consecutive frames and average over all pairs, capturing the stability of appearance over time. (3) Motion accuracy : following [ 11 ] , we use a VLM (InternVL2 [ 60 ] ) to judge whether the generated video depicts the same motion pattern as the reference video, querying each video ten times and reporting the mean accuracy. (4) Motion appropriateness : we use InternVL2 to assess whether the generated motion appears natural, smooth, and physically plausible. Each video is evaluated ten times, and we report the mean score. Additionally, we conduct a user study where 20 volunteers rate generated videos on a 5-point scale across all four dimensions. For each dimension, we randomly select ten examples from the test set and present the generated videos from all methods side by side, reporting the average rating across all volunteers and examples.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 遵循 [13, 9, 12]，我们采用四个指标进行自动评估：（1）外观一致性：我们计算生成视频每一帧与目标图像之间的 CLIP 分数 [59]，然后对所有帧取平均。 这反映了生成视频对目标主体视觉身份的保持程度。 （2）时序一致性：我们计算每对相邻帧之间的 CLIP 分数并对所有帧对取平均，以衡量外观随时间的稳定性。 （3）运动准确性：遵循 [11]，我们使用视觉语言模型（InternVL2 [60]）判断生成视频是否呈现与参考视频相同的运动模式，对每个视频查询十次并报告平均准确率。 （4）运动合理性：我们使用 InternVL2 评估生成的运动是否显得自然、流畅且符合物理合理性。 每个视频评估十次，我们报告平均得分。 此外，我们进行了一项用户研究，让 20 名志愿者对所有四个维度按 5 分制对生成视频进行评分。 对于每个维度，我们从测试集中随机选取十个示例，并将所有方法生成的视频并排展示，报告所有志愿者和所有示例的平均评分。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results. We compare MotionShift with state-of-the-art motion transfer methods, including VideoComposer [ 7 ] , MotionClone [ 9 ] , MotionDirector [ 34 ] , and FlexiAct [ 12 ] . As shown in fig. 5 , VideoComposer and MotionClone exhibit noticeable visual inconsistencies and artifacts in both objects and the surrounding environment, as their dense conditioning tends to rigidly replicate the spatial structure during motion transfer. MotionDirector generates videos with misaligned appearance and motion due to insufficient implicit spatial and temporal fine-tuning. FlexiAct produces visually consistent results but fails to capture object–environment interactions; for example, the mirror does not reflect the walking person and the ball does not fall to the ground. In contrast, MotionShift generates videos with both faithful motion transfer and plausible environment interactions, demonstrating its effectiveness in environment-compatible motion transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 定性结果。 我们将 MotionShift 与最先进的运动迁移方法进行比较，包括 VideoComposer [ 7 ] 、MotionClone [ 9 ] 、MotionDirector [ 34 ] 和 FlexiAct [ 12 ] 。 如图 5 所示，VideoComposer 和 MotionClone 在物体及周围环境中均表现出明显的视觉不一致和伪影，因为其密集条件往往在运动迁移过程中僵硬地复制空间结构。 MotionDirector 由于缺乏足够的隐式空间和时间微调，生成的视频外观与运动不对齐。 FlexiAct 产生了视觉上一致的结果，但未能捕捉物体与环境的交互；例如，镜子没有反射出行走的人，球也没有落到地上。 相比之下，MotionShift 生成的视频既能实现忠实的运动迁移，又能实现合理的环境交互，证明了其在环境兼容运动迁移方面的有效性。

paragraphs.en: We further demonstrate MotionShift’s ability to generalize to complex interactions in fig. 6 . For example, the worker is naturally occluded by the container and walks up the stairs while preserving the basic motion from the reference video. Moreover, the ball follows circular motion in the reference video but, when transferred to a new scene, first spirals along the bowl wall, then gradually slides down due to gravity, decelerates upon hitting the water, and finally floats on the surface. paragraphs.en: Quantitative Results. As shown in table I , MotionShift achieves the best performance across all metrics, outperforming all baselines in both automatic evaluation and user study. Notably, the performance gap is most pronounced on motion appropriateness: MotionShift scores 90.40 in automatic evaluation, compared to 77.60 for the strongest baseline FlexiAct, and achieves a user study rating of 4.68 out of 5 versus 3.57. This large margin on the environment-compatibility-related metrics, relative to the smaller gap on appearance and temporal consistency, confirms that MotionShift’s advantage comes specifically from its environment-aware trajectory adaptation rather than from improvements in rendering quality alone. The user study ratings across all four dimensions further validate the effectiveness of our approach, with MotionShift receiving consistently high scores from human evaluators.
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果。 如表 I 所示，MotionShift 在所有指标上均取得最佳性能，在自动评估和用户研究中均优于所有基线方法。 值得注意的是，性能差距在运动恰当性上最为显著：MotionShift 在自动评估中得分为 90.40，而最强基线 FlexiAct 为 77.60；在用户研究中，MotionShift 获得 5 分制中的 4.68 分，而 FlexiAct 为 3.57 分。 在环境兼容性相关指标上的巨大优势（相对于外观一致性和时间一致性上较小的差距）证实了 MotionShift 的优势具体来源于其环境感知的轨迹自适应，而非仅仅来自渲染质量的提升。 用户研究在全部四个维度上的评分进一步验证了我们方法的有效性，MotionShift 在人类评估者中持续获得高分。

paragraphs.en: Planner–Evaluator Adaptation. To verify the effectiveness of our planner–evaluator design, we compare four variants. As shown in fig. 7 , without adaptation (i.e., using the initial trajectory directly), the horse collides with the fence, producing noticeable artifacts. Using the planner (LLM) alone without the evaluator successfully reasons that the horse should jump, but without visual feedback, its legs still intersect the fence. Using a VLM instead of an LLM as the planner yields results similar to the initial trajectory, as the VLM can perceive visual conflicts but lacks the long-horizon reasoning ability to infer that the horse should jump. Only by combining both—the LLM as planner for motion reasoning and the VLM as evaluator for visual assessment—does the generated video achieve both visual consistency and environment compatibility.
paragraphs.zh: 规划器–评估器自适应。 为验证我们规划器–评估器设计的有效性，我们比较了四种变体。 如图 7 所示，如果不进行自适应（即直接使用初始轨迹），马会撞上栅栏，产生明显的伪影。 仅使用规划器（LLM）而不使用评估器时，能够成功推理出马应该跳跃，但由于没有视觉反馈，马的腿部仍与栅栏相交。 用 VLM 代替 LLM 作为规划器会产生与初始轨迹相似的结果，因为 VLM 能够感知视觉冲突，但缺乏推断出马应该跳跃的长程推理能力。 只有将两者结合——以 LLM 作为规划器进行运动推理，以 VLM 作为评估器进行视觉评估——生成的视频才能同时实现视觉一致性与环境兼容性。

paragraphs.en: Motion-to-Appearance Rendering. We ablate the two-stage rendering design by comparing two variants: (1) generating video directly from the adapted trajectory without semantic masks (w/o mask), and (2) our full pipeline that first generates semantic masks and then renders the final video (w/ mask). As shown in fig. 8 , without the intermediate mask representation, the generated video suffers from distorted object appearance and incorrect motion behavior, as the sparse trajectory alone provides insufficient guidance for the model to faithfully reconstruct both appearance and dynamics. With semantic masks as an intermediate representation, the object appearance and motion are significantly improved, as the masks provide dense, frame-level structural guidance that bridges sparse trajectory control and high-quality video synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 运动到外观渲染。 我们通过对比两个变体来消融两阶段渲染设计：(1) 从适配后的轨迹直接生成视频而不使用语义掩码（无掩码），以及 (2) 我们的完整流程，先生成语义掩码再渲染最终视频（有掩码）。 如图 8 所示，在没有中间掩码表示的情况下，生成的视频会出现物体外观失真和运动行为错误的问题，因为仅有稀疏轨迹不足以引导模型忠实地重建外观与动态。 以语义掩码作为中间表示时，物体外观和运动都得到显著改善，因为掩码提供了稠密的、帧级的结构引导，在稀疏轨迹控制与高质量视频合成之间架起桥梁。

paragraphs.en: The adaptation stage of MotionShift outputs an environment-compatible trajectory and a motion prompt, which can be applied to any trajectory-conditioned I2V model without modification. To verify this, we feed the adapted trajectory into the Go-with-the-Flow [ 61 ] pipeline. As shown in fig. 9 , Go-with-the-Flow produces unnatural videos when following the initial trajectory, such as a robot walking into the sky. When incorporating the environment-compatible trajectory from MotionShift, it produces coherent, natural, and visually harmonious results. This demonstrates that the planner–evaluator adaptation stage is fully decoupled from the rendering backbone and can serve as a general-purpose preprocessing module: since it operates entirely on bounding-box trajectories and natural language, it is agnostic to the choice of downstream I2V model. As a result, any future advancement in trajectory-conditioned video generation can directly benefit from MotionShift’s environment-aware adaptation without retraining or architectural changes.
paragraphs.zh: MotionShift 的适配阶段输出与环境兼容的轨迹和运动提示，可直接应用于任何轨迹条件化的 I2V 模型，无需修改。 为验证这一点，我们将适配后的轨迹输入 Go-with-the-Flow [ 61 ] 流水线。 如 fig. 9 所示，Go-with-the-Flow 在跟随初始轨迹时会产生不自然的视频，例如机器人走进天空。 当结合 MotionShift 输出的环境兼容轨迹时，它能生成连贯、自然且视觉和谐的结果。 这表明规划器—评估器适配阶段与渲染骨干完全解耦，可以作为一个通用的预处理模块：由于它完全基于边界框轨迹和自然语言运行，因此对下游 I2V 模型的选择不敏感。 因此，轨迹条件化视频生成的任何未来进展都可以直接受益于 MotionShift 的环境感知适配，而无需重新训练或修改架构。

paragraphs.en: Our method adopts bounding-box sequences as the motion representation, which effectively captures object-level spatial movements but is inherently unable to represent fine-grained actions such as specific limb postures, deformable object shapes, or articulated body movements. As a result, MotionShift is best suited for transferring holistic object-level motion patterns — such as translation, rotation, and trajectory-level dynamics — rather than detailed action semantics that require part-level control. Extending the framework to support richer motion representations, such as keypoint-based or part-aware trajectories, that can capture fine-grained actions while remaining compatible with environment adaptation remains an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法采用边界框序列作为运动表示，它能有效捕捉物体级空间运动，但天生无法表示细粒度动作，例如具体的肢体姿态、可变形物体的形状或铰接式身体运动。 因此，MotionShift 最适合迁移整体物体级的运动模式——例如平移、旋转以及轨迹级的动态——而非需要部件级控制的细节动作语义。 将该框架扩展以支持更丰富的运动表示，例如基于关键点或部件感知的轨迹，使其在捕捉细粒度动作的同时仍与环境自适应保持兼容，是未来工作的一个重要方向。

paragraphs.en: The planner–evaluator adaptation stage also involves multiple rounds of LLM and VLM inference, which incurs non-trivial computational overhead per sample (approximately 7 minutes per video on a single A800 GPU). paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduce MotionShift, the first framework to address environment-compatible motion transfer. We identify and formalize this task, which requires that the transferred motion remain physically plausible and contextually coherent with the target scene — a challenge largely overlooked by existing motion transfer methods. To address it, we propose a planner–evaluator synergistic adaptation mechanism that iteratively refines motion trajectories through semantic reasoning from an LLM planner and visual feedback from a VLM evaluator, in a training-free manner. The adapted motion is then progressively rendered into the final video through a two-stage pipeline that uses semantic masks as an intermediate representation, decoupling sparse trajectory control from dense appearance synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 MotionShift，这是首个解决环境兼容运动迁移问题的框架。 我们识别并形式化了这一任务，它要求迁移后的运动在物理上合理，并与目标场景在语境上保持一致——这是现有运动迁移方法大多忽视的一个挑战。 为解决该任务，我们提出一种规划器—评估器协同自适应机制，以免训练的方式，通过大语言模型规划器的语义推理和视觉语言模型评估器的视觉反馈，迭代地优化运动轨迹。 随后，适配后的运动通过一个两阶段流水线逐步渲染成最终视频，该流水线以语义掩码作为中间表示，将稀疏的轨迹控制与稠密的外观合成解耦。

sents.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 MotionShift，这是首个解决环境兼容运动迁移问题的框架。

sents.en: We identify and formalize this task, which requires that the transferred motion remain physically plausible and contextually coherent with the target scene — a challenge largely overlooked by existing motion transfer methods.
sents.zh: 我们识别并形式化了这一任务，它要求迁移后的运动在物理上合理，并与目标场景在语境上保持一致——这是现有运动迁移方法大多忽视的一个挑战。

sents.en: To address it, we propose a planner–evaluator synergistic adaptation mechanism that iteratively refines motion trajectories through semantic reasoning from an LLM planner and visual feedback from a VLM evaluator, in a training-free manner.
sents.zh: 为解决该任务，我们提出一种规划器—评估器协同自适应机制，以免训练的方式，通过大语言模型规划器的语义推理和视觉语言模型评估器的视觉反馈，迭代地优化运动轨迹。

sents.en: The adapted motion is then progressively rendered into the final video through a two-stage pipeline that uses semantic masks as an intermediate representation, decoupling sparse trajectory control from dense appearance synthesis.
sents.zh: 随后，适配后的运动通过一个两阶段流水线逐步渲染成最终视频，该流水线以语义掩码作为中间表示，将稀疏的轨迹控制与稠密的外观合成解耦。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionShift achieves superior environment compatibility, motion fidelity, and visual consistency compared to existing baselines. We further show that MotionShift exhibits strong generalization to scenarios involving complex object-environment interactions, and can be readily integrated into existing trajectory-conditioned I2V models as a plugin, improving their physical plausibility without retraining. We believe this work highlights an important but under-explored dimension of controllable video generation, and opens new research directions at the intersection of environment-aware reasoning and physical video synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 大量实验表明，与现有基线相比，MotionShift 在环境兼容性、运动保真度和视觉一致性方面均表现更优。 我们进一步证明，MotionShift 对涉及复杂物体—环境交互的场景具有很强的泛化能力，并且可以作为插件轻松集成到现有的轨迹条件 I2V 模型中，无需重新训练即可提升其物理合理性。 我们相信这项工作突出了可控视频生成中一个重要但尚未被充分探索的维度，并为环境感知推理与物理视频合成的交叉领域开辟了新的研究方向。
